 Persib vs Shan United Ticket Prices for November 19, 2026, Start at IDR 125,000; Here's How to Buy and Season Pass Details
 Tickets for the Persib Bandung vs Shan United match in the 2026/2027 Shopee Cup are now on sale, with single match tickets starting from IDR 125,000 and Season Pass options available.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Niken Pramudya 
 November 12, 2026, 00:51 WITA · 5 min read 
 Photo caption: Illustration of the Persib Bandung squad ahead of the 2026/2027 Shopee Cup match against Shan United at Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium, November 19, 2026. (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 BANDUNG, Aktualita.co -  Tickets for the match Persib Bandung against Shan United in the ASEAN Club Championship or Shopee Cup 2026/2027 are now on sale. Bobotoh who wish to witness Maung Bandung's struggle live at Gelora Bandung Lautan Api (GBLA) Stadium can make purchases through the official PERSIB App. 
 The match Persib vs Shan United is scheduled to take place on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 19:00 WIB or 20:00 WITA. This duel is Persib's second match in the Group B competition of this season's Shopee Cup.

 Based on information announced by the club, match ticket prices are available starting from IDR 125,000 for regular stands up to IDR 400,000 for the Main VIP category. 
 In addition to single-match tickets, Persib also offers a Season Pass, which allows supporters to watch three home matches in the group stage with a single purchase. 
 The ticket sale is important news for Bobotoh who want to support Persib directly, especially after the team recorded different results in their last two matches. 
 List of Persib vs Shan United Ticket Prices 
 Persib management provides several stand categories with different prices. 
 For the match against Shan United on November 19, 2026, the following ticket prices have been announced: 
 Main VIP: IDR 400,000 
 VBU Lounge: IDR 350,000 
 North and South West VIP: IDR 200,000 
 East Stand: IDR 125,000 
 South Stand: IDR 125,000 
 North Stand: IDR 125,000 
 With prices starting from IDR 125,000, Bobotoh have the option to watch the international match from the regular stands. 
 The VIP category offers different seating area options at higher prices. 
 All bookings are directed through the PERSIB App. Ticket availability for each category may change according to the number of seats already booked. 
 Prospective spectators should check the category details, stand location, and payment terms before completing the transaction. 
 Persib Season Pass Still Available, Prices Starting from IDR 350,000 
 In addition to tickets for the match against Shan United, Persib is still selling Season Passes for 2026/2027 Shopee Cup home matches. 
 Information announced on Wednesday (11/11/2026) stated that the season pass covers three of Persib's home matches during the group stage. 
 The Season Pass is available specifically for the East, North, and South stand categories. 
 The following prices are offered: 
 East Stand: IDR 375,000 
 North Stand: IDR 350,000 
 South Stand: IDR 350,000 
 By purchasing a Season Pass, Bobotoh can gain access to three home matches without having to book separately for each game. 
 This option is primarily intended for supporters who plan to attend all of Persib's home matches in the Southeast Asian club competition group stage. 
 However, prospective buyers should note that the Season Pass does not apply to all of Persib's matches in domestic competitions or the AFC Champions League Two. 
 The coverage of the season pass only follows the Shopee Cup matches determined by the club. 
 Three Matches Included in the Persib Season Pass 
 Persib has three home match schedules in the 2026/2027 Shopee Cup Group B stage. 
 The first match is against Shan United from Myanmar on Thursday, November 19, 2026. 
 After that, Persib is scheduled to face Johor Darul Ta'zim from Malaysia on Thursday, December 17, 2026. 
 Meanwhile, the final home match of the group stage pits Maung Bandung against Công An Hà Nội FC from Vietnam on Thursday, March 4, 2027. 
 All three matches are scheduled to take place at Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium. 
 By purchasing one Season Pass package, supporters can secure access to all three matches according to the chosen stand category. 
 However, match schedules and conditions may still be subject to adjustments based on the organizer's decisions. 
 How to Buy Persib vs Shan United Tickets via PERSIB App 
 Purchasing tickets for the Persib vs Shan United match is done through the club's official application. 
 Bobotoh who want to book tickets can follow these steps: 
 Open the PERSIB App on your Android phone or iPhone. 
 Log in using your registered account. 
 Select the Match menu. 
 Find the Persib Bandung vs Shan United match on November 19, 2026. 
 Select the available ticket category. 
 Review the booking details and follow the payment instructions. 
 Complete the transaction using the payment method displayed in the application. 
 For supporters who want to buy a Season Pass, select the Persib vs Shan United match in the Match menu, then tap the Season Pass option. 
 After that, choose the East, North, or South stand, then proceed to payment. 
 Bobotoh are advised to use the official application and not buy tickets through social media accounts or unknown parties offering transactions outside the club's system. 
 This step is important to reduce the risk of fraud or difficulties when verifying tickets at the stadium. 
 Persib Aims for Second Victory in Shopee Cup 
 The match against Shan United is an opportunity for Persib to add points in the 2026/2027 Shopee Cup Group B competition. 
 In the first match on October 8, 2026, Persib successfully defeated Port FC from Thailand with a score of 3-1. 
 That victory is an important asset for Maung Bandung in facing the next series of matches. 
 However, Persib must evaluate after suffering a 1-2 defeat to Java United in the Super League on Sunday (8/11/2026). 
 The result makes the match against Shan United an opportunity to rebuild positive momentum. 
 Persib is also facing fitness challenges due to a tight schedule in three competitions. 
 Coach Igor Tolić previously highlighted the physical condition of several players after a series of matches and exhausting travel. 
 The November international break provides an opportunity for the team to recover their fitness before playing again on November 19. 
 Bobotoh's support at GBLA Stadium is expected to be an additional motivation for Marc Klok and his teammates to secure three points. 
 Bobotoh Need to Secure Tickets Before the Match 
 The ticket sales that have opened provide an opportunity for supporters to plan their attendance in advance. 
 For Bobotoh who only want to attend the match against Shan United, regular tickets are an option with prices starting from IDR 125,000. 
 Meanwhile, the Season Pass can be considered by supporters who plan to watch all of Persib's home matches in the Shopee Cup group stage. 
 Before buying, supporters should ensure the stand category, match coverage, and ticket usage terms. 
 The Persib vs Shan United match on November 19, 2026, is Maung Bandung's closest agenda in the Shopee Cup as well as an opportunity to maintain their chances of competing for the knockout phase. 
 Ticket availability and the latest information can be checked directly through the PERSIB App.
